rev6.release_notes: G-SEND.IO opens maximized every time. Tool Definitions: the mouse wheel no longer changes values by accident, and MILL CUTTER tools show as a face mill.

cadcam.release_notes: A part now keeps the tools it was programmed with: it posts the same code on any computer's tool library, and says so when that library holds a different tool (the part's tools can be added to the library when it opens). Saved toolpaths and processes: right-click to save one or several, insert them into any setup. Save Setting / Restore Setting on any value in a toolpath window. Post Builder (Utilities): teach it your machine's code from a sample part or your own program, and it builds a post that writes that format. Part Properties, Measure (edge length, diameter, distance between faces, angles), Interference, Simplify and Emboss / Engrave. New CAM and CAD ribbons; toolpaths show only while picked; every Quick toolpath shows only the dimensions that place it. New parts open in CAD. The AI connection is fixed on every install and update. Parts saved by this version use file format 6; an older version opens them read-only.
